campaign.title: Pledge a family’s Ramadan, before it begins.
campaign.text: Ramadan is expected to begin around 8 February 2027. Thirty dollars puts rice, lentils, flour, oil and dates in a family’s home for the whole month, so no one breaks their fast hungry.
